title: pm relay: no door can rewrite a PR body after round 1; the dev writes it once (os-dev.md), and a seat issue_patch must open with its signature, which breaks the Fixes-first body shape
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① a process gap, measured on PR #29083 (#28912). Its contract review 6572308637 asked, as a should-fix, that the body be updated before landing, because the round-1 body contradicts the tree. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: the dev writes the PR body once, at `pr_create`, and later edits belong to the seat.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`SIGNED_EDIT_OPS`, #27113): a seat's `issue_patch` carrying a `body` must open with the seat's signature line. Only `pr_create` is exempt, because a PR body's first line is `Fixes #n`.
- So after a FAIL round, nobody can bring the body to the new head. The dev may not, and the seat can only do it by putting a signature above `Fixes #n`.
- Seen on PR #28920 (the body cites the round-1 head), PR #29014 and PR #29083 (the body says no D3 entry is added; the tree has one). Each time the seat record carried the current-head reading instead.

## Wanted

One door that keeps the body honest after round 2+. Either:
- exempt a PR body `issue_patch` from the signature rule, the way `pr_create` is exempt, with the signature carried elsewhere (for example an HTML comment trailer); or
- let the dev `issue_patch` its own PR body, and say so in os-dev.md and the standard orders.

Reader who acts: the owner of `scripts/pm/fleet-write` and the pm-dispatch skill (`.claude/**` is governed, Tier S/H).

Dedupe: searched `issue_patch PR body signature`; only #27113 (the ruling that created the rule). **New.**
